reports.title: MACOM Reports Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: For the fiscal first quarter ending January 1, 2027, MACOM expects revenue to be in the range of $450 million to $460 million. Adjusted gross margin is expected to be between 62.0% and 63.0%, and adjusted earnings per diluted share is expected to be between $2.21 and $2.29 utilizing an anticipated non-GAAP income tax rate of 6% and 79.0 million fully diluted shares outstanding.
